test_gmock_output: test the GMockOutputTest class to verify normalized gmock output matches the golden file
run_gmock_output_test: run the gmock output test script with --gengolden flag to regenerate the golden file
normalize_gmock_output: normalize gmock test output by removing headers, locations, memory addresses, and error markers
extract_leaky_tests: extract test names of leaked mock objects from gmock test output using regex patterns
run_gmock_command: run a gmock test command in a subprocess and return its normalized output with leaky test names
